follow-up time: duration of pregnancy and postpartum period
exposure: acute or chronic genital or extragenital infections
reactivation of chronic infections/inflammatory diseases during current pregnancy
history of obstetric complications during previous pregnancies such as miscarriages, missed miscarriages, preterm deliveries, postpartum endometritis, and sepsis
outcome: preterm premature rupture of fetal membranes
cohort: 355 pregnant women with a high risk of chronic infections
finding: Pregnancies in women with a high risk of chronic infections were associated with high rates of recurrent threatened pregnancy loss, preterm premature rupture of membranes, preterm delivery, and inflammatory complications postpartum.
mod_finding: Pregnancies in women with a high risk of chronic infections were associated with high rates of recurrent threatened pregnancy loss, preterm rupture of membranes and preterm delivery.
